title: How to Use Claude Code: 2026 Beginner Guide + 18 Commands

facts.fact: Anthropic's pricing page lists the Pro plan at $20 a month, or $17 a month billed annually ($200 a year), with Claude Code included.
facts.quote: $20 a month, or $17 a month billed annually ($200 a year)

facts.fact: The Max plan starts at $100 a month and offers 5x or 20x the usage of Pro, with Claude Code included.
facts.quote: From $100 a month, for 5x or 20x the usage of Pro

facts.fact: The Team plan's standard seat costs $25 a month ($20 billed annually), and its premium seat costs $125 ($100 billed annually) with 5x the usage of a standard seat.
facts.quote: Standard seat $25 a month ($20 billed annually); premium seat $125 ($100 billed annually)

facts.fact: The Enterprise plan is listed at $20 per seat a month billed annually, plus usage at API rates.
facts.quote: $20 per seat a month billed annually, plus usage at API rates

facts.fact: Claude Code is not included in the Free Claude plan.
facts.quote: The Free plan does not include it

facts.fact: On older Enterprise plans, Claude Code is available only with the Chat + Claude Code or Premium seats.
facts.quote: On older Enterprise plans, Claude Code comes only with Chat + Claude Code or Premium seats.

facts.fact: On Pro and Max, Claude and Claude Code share the same usage limits, consisting of a five-hour session limit and a weekly limit.
facts.quote: On Pro and Max, Claude and Claude Code draw on the same usage limits: a five-hour session limit and a weekly limit.

facts.fact: A Claude Console account lets users pay per use with prepaid API credits billed at API rates.
facts.quote: A Claude Console account with prepaid API credits, billed at API rates

facts.fact: If an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable is set and the user approves it, a Claude Code session bills that key at API rates instead of using the subscription.
facts.quote: the session bills that key at API rates instead of using your subscription

facts.fact: Auto mode is the starting permission mode for terminal and VS Code sessions on Claude Code v2.1.283 or later.
facts.quote: Auto mode for terminal and VS Code sessions on v2.1.283 or later.

facts.fact: The Claude Code VS Code extension requires VS Code 1.94.0 or later.
facts.quote: It needs VS Code 1.94.0 or later.

facts.fact: The Claude desktop app's Code tab runs on macOS and Windows, with Linux support in beta.
facts.quote: for macOS and Windows, with Linux in beta

facts.fact: The guide states that the pricing figures were checked against the claude.com pricing page on October 8, 2026.
The page gives the macOS, Linux and WSL install command as a curl one-liner from claude.ai/install.sh.
Users can undo changes in a Claude Code session by pressing Esc twice or running /rewind to restore code and conversation to an earlier point.
facts.quote: Press Esc twice or run `/rewind` to restore code and conversation to an earlier point
